insight: Started as an open-source hack generating audio from spectrogram images; its FUZZ model now ranks near the top of public music leaderboards.
name: Riffusion
tagline: Free AI music generator that creates full songs from text, audio, or images.
description: An AI music platform that generates complete songs from text descriptions, audio clips, or visual prompts using its FUZZ model. Born from an open-source project that synthesized music by generating spectrogram images with Stable Diffusion, it now runs as a free web app and mobile apps with a daily-credit free tier and paid credits for heavier use.

modelSupport.notes: Generates with Riffusion's own FUZZ music model; no user model selection.
